hooks.text: 开局先选两个昆虫氏族结盟，联盟会同步决定可用单位、装备、饰品和协同。
hooks.excerpt: In Hive Blight, you’ll start by choosing an alliance between two clans, shaping your available units, equipment, trinkets, and synergies.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: Vespadas主攻与减益、Cabbale用毒和伏击、Symphoney靠治疗与魅惑，跨氏族还能组合出意外连招。
hooks.excerpt: Each clan has its own playstyle: the Vespadas excel in offense and debuffs, the Silent Cabbale use poison and ambush tactics, and the Sweet Symphoney rely on healing and seduction. Combine the clan cleverly, like pairing the Cabbale’s ambush with the Vespadas’ brute force, and you might discover combos even we didn’t predict.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 旅途中可买装备、寻找失落祭坛、喝神秘药水或使用锻炉，以路线决策强化虫群。
hooks.excerpt: Explore its lush environment to find ways to improve your troops! Find or buy equipment , discover sacred altars with long lost powers, drink mysterious potions to boost your unit or visit the forge ! There are many ways for you to get stronger, make wise decisions on the road to get there!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
